notes.title: Here comes Version 3.0!
notes.notes:
[h3][b]Long time no see, brothers and sisters![/b][/h3]
After my continuous hard work and learning, I have finally achieved something I’ve always wanted: the game lobby and the ability to join games in progress. It may sound simple, but for a randomly generated map, it’s still a bit challenging.
This update adds a new weirdo, new abilities, new achievements, and optimizations for other content. Since there is no development team, there will definitely be some bugs. If you find a bug, you can leave a comment on this page, or tell me on Discord or QQ, and I’ll fix it as soon as possible.
If you still want to play the previous stable version, right-click the game in your Steam library, go to Properties, and change the beta branch to the “stable” version. Also, I hope those who haven’t left a positive review yet could give one — your positive feedback is my motivation to keep updating!

[h3][b]Background story of The Starver[/b][/h3]
He came from another universe, cruelly betrayed by an undercover teammate, and ultimately died far from home. Just before his death, a flash of white light teleported him into our building. I believe our fellow building managers will know how to take good care of this new neighbor.
Because he never had a full meal in his life, our new neighbor is as skinny as a monkey. But don’t underestimate him — he’s much tougher than he looks.
(Friendly tip: The kid has never eaten his fill — give him something tasty and he’ll be quite happy.)

[h3][b]Update contents[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]The building manager’s health has been reduced across all difficulties. Many friends said the building manager was too hard to defeat. Actually, as long as you make it to the top floor, that’s already impressive enough — it counts as clearing the game. There’s no need to force yourself to take down the building manager. But if you really want to challenge him, you’ll need to be well prepared: a powerful weapon, a few hearts to stay alive, some bottles of DDV to deal with the weirdos he summons, and so on. I won’t list everything here — more techniques are waiting for you to discover!
[*]Added game lobby! Players can now join other players’ games in progress. There may be bugs, so remember to leave feedback
[*]New weirdo: The Starver
[*]New item: Essence of Starver
[*]Added help documentation for The Starver — find it to learn more
[*]Added missions to defeat and devour The Starver
[*]New achievement for defeating The Starved
[*]New ability: Starved Enfeeble
[*]Expanded the pickup range for small items, making them easier to collect
[*]Player’s personal storage box now has a chance to spawn in rooms
[*]Added text chat function
[*]Added camera shake effect while running (can be disabled in settings)
[*]Defeated players can now be devoured — don’t waste food; devour them for an achievement
[*]Fixed some minor bugs
[/list]

notes.title: STASH UPDATE!
notes.notes:
So the other day on a sudden whim, I thought, why not create a personal stash system? Sometimes players get insanely lucky and find an infinity item. If they could stash it away for next time or show it off to friends, wouldn't that be great? So, this update was born. But making it a reality turned out to be a real pain... Still, after overcoming numerous difficulties, it finally got done...

Players can now randomly find personal stashes on the map to store their precious items and use them in the next game. But be careful, once you take an item out, if you lose it, it's gone for good. Additionally, I've added new abilities: one that lets you summon the personal stash at any time and another advanced ability that automatically stashes your items when you die.

[list]
[*]Added stash system
[*]Added new ability: Stash
[*]Added new advanced ability: Pusillanimous
[*]Added an achievement for stashing over 100 gold bars
[*]Added an achievement for stashing over 100 fynchenite hearts
[*]Added an achievement for stashing over 100 obsidian hearts
[*]Added option to change anti-aliasing
[*]Changed some interactive hints
[/list]

notes.title: Artifact Update!
notes.notes:
What if you are rich and you want a good start, or if you want to show off to your fellow newcomer friends? Well fear not, it is getting easier than ever (if you are rich)! This mysterious floating object just came out of nowhere and you can buy good sheet from the "Artifact" on floor1 and carry them all (if you are rich)! Also, you can sell your salvaged sheet to it and earn some points as well, another way to earn points, yay!

PS: If you are a newbie, forget about buying from it, no offense, you can't afford them.
 
[list]
[*]Added a valuable item shop "Artifact" on floor1 for those of you who have a lot of points and nowhere to spend
[*]Added an achievement for successfully sell an item to the Artifact
[*]Added an achievement for trying to rob the Artifact
[*]Added an achievement for buying a blind box for the Artifact
[*]Added more mission contracts in the mission room on floor1
[*]Adjusted total floor levels for each difficulty
[*]Item sell price will also be affected by game difficulty, more risk more reward!
[*]Fixed a bug causing wanderers won't lock crouched players in place
[/list]

notes.title: NEW UPDATE!
notes.notes:
After Reaper moved in, one of his friends is comming as well for his protection, his name is Minion.
Minion is probably the weakest almong them all, but he is rich, and he always carries currency with him! More importantly, if Minion got put down, one of his brothers Minion No.2 will appear on the same floor level! This means, he can be farmed for currency, not that I encourage it, since robbing is bad.
